title: Optimize vector zero-limit search
constraints: Preserve missing-index and dimension mismatch errors
rationale: VectorIndex::search with k = 0 returned no rows but still proceeded to lazy HNSW build and search after dimension validation. A zero-limit fast path avoids unnecessary index work while keeping validation behavior for existing error cases.
steps: Return Ok(empty) for k = 0 after the index exists and query dimension is validated
Add focused unit coverage that zero-limit search skips lazy build but still validates dimension
expected_impact: Avoids unnecessary HNSW lazy build/search work for callers that request zero vector results.
